notes: Gauntling Graft Bay, 4x4: a top-down repair bay on mismatched plates: a steel work table with a half-assembled limb, two jointed robot arms from the top corners that weld the limb together (a bright arc flickers and the arms shift on the 4-frame loop), a rack of spare hands and gears along the bottom and a hazard strip because organics are not welcome. Off: arms folded, table dark. Damaged: an arm is jammed at an angle and sparking, a plate lifts, the weld arc stutters. Disabled: both arms hanging limp, the table cracked, spares spilled.
